_comment: Focused probes for physio_cure's RETURNING PATIENT LOOKUP OFFER patch (2026-09-17).

scenarios.name: Repeat-visit booking for a named third party triggers the offer, not immediate book_intent

history.content: Hi, can I please book, uh, my next, uh, next appointment for Kevin Rolfs?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS only if the agent's entire spoken output is exactly 'If they've been to the clinic before I can find their previous appointment so you can easily book another. Would that be helpful?' with zero tool calls. FAIL if the agent instead acks and calls universal_router intent='book_intent' immediately (the old Signal 1 behavior) — the repeat-visit language 'next appointment' must trigger this offer block first.

scenarios.name: Repeat-visit language buried after booking language still triggers the offer (not just when it opens the sentence)

history.content: Hi, can I book an appointment — my next one, actually, for Kevin Rolfs?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS only if the agent's entire spoken output is exactly 'If they've been to the clinic before I can find their previous appointment so you can easily book another. Would that be helpful?' with zero tool calls. FAIL if the agent instead acks and calls universal_router intent='book_intent' immediately — the leading 'book an appointment' phrasing must not cause Signal 1 to fire before the trailing 'my next one' repeat-visit language is scanned. This is the live failure mode found 2026-09-17: Haiku spoke Signal 1's ack ('Lovely! Let me get that sorted for you.') and skipped straight to book_intent/Node 2's category question, never asking the offer, because Signal 1's own zero-clarifying-questions rules (NO-DEFAULT RULE / CRITICAL EXECUTE RULE) were suppressing this block despite its priority-scan position.

scenarios.name: Exact live failure transcript (2026-09-17): plain 'book next appointment for Kevin Rolfs' with no leave-message phrase must not let INTENT-IN-MESSAGE INTERCEPT's GATE fallback skip straight to Signal 1

history.content: You've reached Physio Cure AI receptionist! How can I help you?
Hi, can I please book next appointment for Kevin Rolfs?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS only if the agent's entire spoken output is exactly 'If they've been to the clinic before I can find their previous appointment so you can easily book another. Would that be helpful?' with zero tool calls. FAIL if the agent instead speaks any Signal 1 ack (e.g. 'Lovely! Let me get that sorted for you.') and calls universal_router intent='book_intent' — this is the exact live call that failed on 2026-09-17. Root cause found afterward: INTENT-IN-MESSAGE INTERCEPT's GATE, evaluated earlier in the prompt, says 'this entire INTERCEPT block does NOT fire — skip it and continue to the next PRIORITY SCAN block below, then ROUTING SIGNALS' when no leave-message phrase is present (as here) — the GATE's fallback previously named 'SIGNAL 2B or SIGNAL 1' directly, which primed the model to jump straight past AI CAPABILITY REDIRECT and this RETURNING PATIENT LOOKUP OFFER block entirely, even though both sit between the GATE and ROUTING SIGNALS in the prompt. Fixed fleet-wide in nodes/node1_templates/*.txt (2026-09-17) plus a physio_cure-specific DISAMBIGUATION EXAMPLE anchoring this exact sentence.

scenarios.name: Caller agrees to the offer — fires details_past with return_node=1

history.content: Hi, can I please book my next appointment for Kevin Rolfs?
If they've been to the clinic before I can find their previous appointment so you can easily book another. Would that be helpful?
Yes please

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS only if the agent speaks 'Checking that now, one moment.' AND in the same response calls universal_router with intent='details_past', called_number, caller_id, and payload containing return_node='1', booking_for='other', and family_member_name='Kevin Rolfs' (the original request named Kevin, so the lookup itself must carry the third-party context — without it the backend looks up the CALLER and node_1c opens in its self-wording). FAIL if patient_name is included in the payload (this node's details_past call is phone-only, per the shared system prompt's NAME-ONLY SEARCH FORBIDDEN rule), or if return_node, booking_for or family_member_name is omitted, or if the tool call and spoken phrase are not both present.
